# The environments' var files hold no secret values (see README.md):
# commit them.
!vars/**/*.tfvars
-- README.md --
# aws/eu-west-2

Generated by infraharvest: one root whose code every environment shares (dev, stage, prod). What differs between them is in `vars/<env>/`: `terraform.tfvars` holds the values that differ from the defaults in `variables.tf`, `imports.tfvars` the IDs `imports.tf` imports, and `backend.hcl` where the state is kept.

| Environment | `env` | Account | Region |
|---|---|---|---|
| dev | `dev` | 111111111111 | eu-west-2 |
| stage | `stg` | 333333333333 | eu-west-2 |
| prod | `prd` | 222222222222 | eu-west-2 |

## Plan and apply an environment

Run each environment with its own credentials: the provider block sets no role of its own. For dev, and likewise for the others:

```sh
terraform init
terraform workspace select -or-create dev
terraform plan -var-file=vars/common.tfvars -var-file=vars/dev/terraform.tfvars -var-file=vars/dev/imports.tfvars
terraform apply -var-file=vars/common.tfvars -var-file=vars/dev/terraform.tfvars -var-file=vars/dev/imports.tfvars
```

Without a backend, each environment keeps its state in the workspace named after it, in `terraform.tfstate.d/<env>/`, which `infraharvest drift` reads. Plan each environment before its first apply: it should import every resource and change nothing else.

## After the first apply

Once every environment has been applied, delete `imports.tf` and each `vars/<env>/imports.tfvars`, and leave `-var-file=vars/<env>/imports.tfvars` out of the commands.

## Secrets

Set `db_instance_password`, `shop_prd_api_key` for each environment from your secret store, or with `TF_VAR_<name>`, never in a var file. infraharvest never writes secret values into the configuration.
-- imports.tf --
# Each environment imports its resources on its first apply, with their IDs
# from vars/<env>/imports.tfvars. Delete this file, and those, after it.

import {
  to = aws_cloudwatch_log_group.app
  id = var.import_ids["aws_cloudwatch_log_group.app"]
}

import {
  for_each = [for k in [0] : k if var.deploy_db_instance]

  to = aws_db_instance.main[each.value]
  id = var.import_ids["aws_db_instance.main[0]"]
}

import {
  for_each = [for k in [0] : k if var.deploy_alerts_dev]

  to = aws_sns_topic.alerts_dev[each.value]
  id = var.import_ids["aws_sns_topic.alerts_dev[0]"]
}

import {
  for_each = [for k in [0] : k if var.deploy_alerts_prod]

  to = aws_sns_topic.alerts_prod[each.value]
  id = var.import_ids["aws_sns_topic.alerts_prod[0]"]
}

import {
  for_each = [for k in [0] : k if var.deploy_alerts_stage]

  to = aws_sns_topic.alerts_stage[each.value]
  id = var.import_ids["aws_sns_topic.alerts_stage[0]"]
}

import {
  for_each = var.sqs_queues

  to = aws_sqs_queue.this[each.key]
  id = var.import_ids[format("aws_sqs_queue.this[%q]", each.key)]
}

import {
  for_each = [for k in [0] : k if var.deploy_api_key]

  to = aws_ssm_parameter.api_key[each.value]
  id = var.import_ids["aws_ssm_parameter.api_key[0]"]
}
-- locals.tf --
locals {
  naming_prefix = "shop-${var.env}"

  # logs
  app_name = "/shop/${var.env}/app"

  # rds
  db_instance_name = "${local.naming_prefix}-db"
}
-- logs.tf --
resource "aws_cloudwatch_log_group" "app" {
  name              = local.app_name
  retention_in_days = var.app_retention_in_days
}
-- providers.tf --
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.7, < 2.0"

  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 6.14"
    }
  }
}

provider "aws" {
  region              = var.aws_region
  allowed_account_ids = var.allowed_account_ids
}
-- rds.tf --
resource "aws_db_instance" "main" {
  count = var.deploy_db_instance ? 1 : 0

  identifier        = local.db_instance_name
  allocated_storage = 20
  engine            = "postgres"
  instance_class    = "db.t3.micro"
  password          = var.db_instance_password
}
-- sns.tf --
resource "aws_sns_topic" "alerts_dev" {
  count = var.deploy_alerts_dev ? 1 : 0

  name              = "shop-dev-alerts"
  display_name      = "Shop alerts"
  kms_master_key_id = "alias/one"
  tracing_config    = "PassThrough"
}

resource "aws_sns_topic" "alerts_prod" {
  count = var.deploy_alerts_prod ? 1 : 0

  name              = "shop-prd-alerts"
  display_name      = "Shop production alerts"
  kms_master_key_id = "alias/three"
  tracing_config    = "PassThrough"
}

resource "aws_sns_topic" "alerts_stage" {
  count = var.deploy_alerts_stage ? 1 : 0

  name              = "shop-stg-alerts"
  display_name      = "Shop staging alerts"
  kms_master_key_id = "alias/two"
  tracing_config    = "Active"
}
-- sqs.tf --
resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  for_each = var.sqs_queues

  name                       = each.value.name
  delay_seconds              = 0
  visibility_timeout_seconds = 30
}
-- ssm.tf --
resource "aws_ssm_parameter" "api_key" {
  count = var.deploy_api_key ? 1 : 0

  name  = "/shop/prd/api-key"
  type  = "SecureString"
  value = var.shop_prd_api_key
}
-- variables.tf --
variable "env" {
  description = "The token that stands for the environment in names."
  type        = string

  validation {
    condition     = contains(["dev", "stg", "prd"], var.env)
    error_message = "env must be one of dev, stg, prd."
  }
}

variable "aws_region" {
  description = "The AWS region of the stack."
  type        = string
  default     = "eu-west-2"
}

variable "allowed_account_ids" {
  description = "The allowed_account_ids of the aws provider."
  type        = list(string)
}

variable "app_retention_in_days" {
  description = "The retention_in_days of aws_cloudwatch_log_group.app."
  type        = number
  default     = 7
}

variable "db_instance_password" {
  description = "The password of aws_db_instance.main."
  type        = string
  default     = null
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "deploy_alerts_dev" {
  description = "Whether the environment has aws_sns_topic.alerts_dev."
  type        = bool
  default     = false
}

variable "deploy_alerts_prod" {
  description = "Whether the environment has aws_sns_topic.alerts_prod."
  type        = bool
  default     = false
}

variable "deploy_alerts_stage" {
  description = "Whether the environment has aws_sns_topic.alerts_stage."
  type        = bool
  default     = false
}

variable "deploy_api_key" {
  description = "Whether the environment has aws_ssm_parameter.api_key."
  type        = bool
  default     = false
}

variable "deploy_db_instance" {
  description = "Whether the environment has aws_db_instance.main."
  type        = bool
  default     = false
}

variable "sqs_queues" {
  description = "The instances of aws_sqs_queue.this in the environment, by key."
  type        = map(object({ name = optional(string) }))
}

variable "shop_prd_api_key" {
  description = "The value of aws_ssm_parameter.api_key."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
  default     = null
}

variable "import_ids" {
  description = "The import ID of each resource the environment imports, by its address: vars/<env>/imports.tfvars sets it for imports.tf."
  type        = map(string)
  default     = {}
}
-- vars/common.tfvars --
# Values every environment shares, which the defaults in variables.tf don't
# give: none yet. Each environment's own are in vars/<env>/terraform.tfvars.
-- vars/dev/imports.tfvars --
# The import ID of each resource of the dev environment, for imports.tf on
# its first apply. Delete this file with imports.tf after it.
import_ids = {
  "aws_cloudwatch_log_group.app"   = "/shop/dev/app"
  "aws_sns_topic.alerts_dev[0]"    = "arn:aws:sns:eu-west-2:111111111111:shop-dev-alerts"
  "aws_sqs_queue.this[\"orders\"]" = "https://sqs.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com/111111111111/shop-dev-orders"
}
-- vars/dev/terraform.tfvars --
# The dev environment's values that differ from the defaults in
# variables.tf. Secrets are never set here: see README.md.
env = "dev"

# providers
allowed_account_ids = ["111111111111"]

# sns
deploy_alerts_dev = true

# sqs
sqs_queues = {
  "orders" = {
    name = "shop-dev-orders"
  }
}
-- vars/prod/imports.tfvars --
# The import ID of each resource of the prod environment, for imports.tf on
# its first apply. Delete this file with imports.tf after it.
import_ids = {
  "aws_cloudwatch_log_group.app"    = "/shop/prd/app"
  "aws_db_instance.main[0]"         = "shop-prd-db"
  "aws_sns_topic.alerts_prod[0]"    = "arn:aws:sns:eu-west-2:222222222222:shop-prd-alerts"
  "aws_sqs_queue.this[\"orders\"]"  = "https://sqs.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com/222222222222/shop-prd-orders"
  "aws_sqs_queue.this[\"refunds\"]" = "https://sqs.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com/222222222222/shop-prd-refunds"
  "aws_ssm_parameter.api_key[0]"    = "/shop/prd/api-key"
}
-- vars/prod/terraform.tfvars --
# The prod environment's values that differ from the defaults in
# variables.tf. Secrets are never set here: see README.md.
env = "prd"

# logs
app_retention_in_days = 90

# providers
allowed_account_ids = ["222222222222"]

# rds
deploy_db_instance = true

# sns
deploy_alerts_prod = true

# sqs
sqs_queues = {
  "orders" = {
    name = "shop-prd-orders"
  }
  "refunds" = {
    name = "shop-prd-refunds"
  }
}

# ssm
deploy_api_key = true
-- vars/stage/imports.tfvars --
# The import ID of each resource of the stage environment, for imports.tf on
# its first apply. Delete this file with imports.tf after it.
import_ids = {
  "aws_cloudwatch_log_group.app"   = "/shop/stg/app"
  "aws_db_instance.main[0]"        = "shop-stg-db"
  "aws_sns_topic.alerts_stage[0]"  = "arn:aws:sns:eu-west-2:333333333333:shop-stg-alerts"
  "aws_sqs_queue.this[\"orders\"]" = "https://sqs.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com/333333333333/shop-stg-orders"
}
-- vars/stage/terraform.tfvars --
# The stage environment's values that differ from the defaults in
# variables.tf. Secrets are never set here: see README.md.
env = "stg"

# providers
allowed_account_ids = ["333333333333"]

# rds
deploy_db_instance = true

# sns
deploy_alerts_stage = true

# sqs
sqs_queues = {
  "orders" = {
    name = "shop-stg-orders"
  }
}
